# Third-party source

`traktor_stem_bridge/sidecar.py` is from [zicez/traktor-stem-bridge](https://github.com/zicez/traktor-stem-bridge), commit `c155fc4adc17c92629b033865f467691fa965f10`, Copyright (c) 2026 Thanh Nha, MIT license. Its license is included alongside the source. The path calculation is interoperability metadata; it does not perform separation or change Traktor.

Other private tools and model weights live outside this repository. No Traktor executable, DLL, resource, decompiled function, user collection or music is included.
